Public course sites for students and visitors. Current students should still use the LMS for this term’s materials.

## Current / upcoming

::: {.editorial-index}
1. [**MATH 107: Linear Algebra**](https://roverhol.github.io/math107/)  
   Cal Poly Humboldt — Public course site.

2. [**DATA 422: Advanced Data Science Methods and Ethics**](https://roverhol.github.io/data422/)  
   Cal Poly Humboldt — Public course site.

3. [**DATA 311: Applied Data Analysis**](https://roverhol.github.io/data-311-public/)  
   Fall 2025 · Cal Poly Humboldt — Data cleaning, visualization, and predictive modeling on real problems.

4. [**STAT 109: Introductory Biostatistics**](https://roverhol.github.io/stat109-public/)  
   Spring 2026 · Cal Poly Humboldt — Statistical methods and R for students in the natural and health sciences.
:::
